wrap_torch_function_with_numpy: wrap a torch function to accept numpy arrays as input and return numpy arrays as output
wrap_torch_function_with_unsqueeze: wrap a torch function with unsqueeze to automatically add and remove batch dimensions around numpy conversions
deterministic_random_value: generate a deterministic random integer within a range from a string seed using sha256 hashing
convert_numpy_to_tensor_seamlessly: convert numpy arrays to torch tensors and back automatically when calling torch functions
reproduce_random_values_deterministicall: reproduce the same random value across runs by passing the same string data to deterministic_random
